# `company.pick_list_shipments`

Immutable: a shipment posted from a pick list for one of its orders. Live while the shipment is not voided.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this link. |

| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + shipment_id | ix_pick_list_shipments_shipment | shipments.id | Shipment posted from it. |
| `sales_order_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | work_documents.id | Order the shipment shipped. |

| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this pick list shipment. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this pick list shipment. |
